source.organization: New York Department of State, Division of Corporations (via data.ny.gov)

transport.rate_limit: Socrata throttles anonymous; optional free app token raises limits

parsing.notes: Socrata: page with $limit/$offset (or download the full CSV). Redact dos_process person names. State-scoped dos_id; no national join.

mapping_rules.company_id: Use dos_id (NY-scoped; prefix with state if combining states).
mapping_rules.registered_location: Only county + service-of-process available (no principal street address).
mapping_rules.note: Pattern replicable for other free states (Washington data.wa.gov, Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut, Iowa, Minnesota).

fixture_requirements: record with process agent name (verify redaction)

live_test_plan.full: Page $limit=50000/$offset, or download rows.csv; load to NDJSON keyed on dos_id; redact process names.

blockers: State-scoped id only (no national US company id).
Service-of-process fields may be personal data — redact.
Comprehensive US coverage needs ~51 separate state sources.
